title: huperzia somae
intro: Huperzia somae, commonly known as the toothed club moss, is a species of plant in the Huperziaceae family. This plant is a type of lycopod, which is an ancient group of vascular plants. Huperzia somae is known for its potential health benefits, which include improving cognitive function, neuroprotection, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include huperzine A, a potent inhibitor of acetylcholinesterase, which is responsible for its therapeutic actions, including memory enhancement and neuroprotection.
